decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several backpack styles, including tactical packs, sling bags, and a cooler backpack. The QT&QY 45L tactical backpack (prod_backpacks_057) stood out as the best overall choice due to its high rating of 4.7 across over 6,000 reviews, indicating consistent quality. It offers significant capacity (45L) at a very competitive price of $39.99. While the Maxpedition (prod_backpacks_096) is a high-end alternative, its price of $171.67 is significantly higher without a proportionate increase in user-rated satisfaction for general utility. The sling and cooler bags were too specialized for this browsing session.
